issue.title: tui_perf.md rule 3 cites _submit_tracked_proc, removed by the durable proc observer migration
issue.description:
Rule 3 in `sase/memory/tui_perf.md` (line ~31) asserts that long-running work must be
submitted "as a tracked task via `_submit_tracked_proc()` (`proc_actions.py`)". That
symbol no longer exists in production code: commit `8c4840458` ("feat(ace): observe
durable procs read-only", bead sase-m9.3.1.4) moved ACE proc handling to a
supervisor-backed observer projection, and `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/proc_actions.py`
now defines only `ProcActionsMixin` (45 lines). `_submit_tracked_proc` survives only in
the test harness `tests/_agent_cleanup_proc_helpers.py:114`.

The production analogs are `_submit_launch_proc`
(`src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agent_workflow/_launch_procs.py:57`, `LaunchProcMixin`) and
`_submit_cleanup_proc` (`src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_cleanup_procs.py:34`,
`CleanupProcMixin`), which delegate to `submit_agent_launch` / `submit_agent_cleanup`
in `agent_durable`.

Impact: agents following the tui_perf rules verbatim reference a dead symbol; the
`tailnet_fleet_federation` research report (202609) had to correct a researcher who
copied the stale citation into a design document.

Fix: update the rule to name the durable-submit path (`submit_agent_launch` /
`submit_agent_cleanup` via the proc mixins, observed read-only by ACE) instead of
`_submit_tracked_proc()`. Memory edits go through the `/sase_memory_write` flow.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Replace the _submit_tracked_proc()/proc_actions.py citation in rule 3 with the current durable-submit path: _submit_launch_proc/_submit_cleanup_proc mixins delegating to submit_agent_launch/submit_agent_cleanup in agent_durable, observed read-only by ACE.
